extracted.intended_audience: community organizations, arts and culture organizations, local governments, and other applicants seeking NEA Our Town grants
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for applicants to the National Endowment for the Arts Our Town program, which funds creative placemaking projects that integrate arts, culture, and design to achieve local community outcomes. Covers the program's primary eligibility and focus criteria and how to apply within Grants for Arts Projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for creative placemaking
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Town grants support creative placemaking projects that integrate arts, culture, and design in efforts to advance local economic, physical, and other community-desired outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the overarching purpose of the program: projects should be framed as creative placemaking with the explicit goal of producing local community benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration of arts, culture, and design
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects must integrate arts, culture, and design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Successful proposals should show how artistic practice, cultural programming, and design strategies work together rather than operating in isolation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance local economic, physical, and other community-desired outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should advance local economic, physical, and other community-desired outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outcomes may include economic development, improvements to physical spaces, or other results defined by the community; proposals should articulate the intended local impacts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Place-specific requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects must be place-specific (such as a community, neighborhood, or cultural district).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program funds interventions tied to a defined place—examples given include a community, neighborhood, or cultural district—rather than purely virtual or non-geographic efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on community priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should focus on community priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should demonstrate alignment with priorities identified by the community being served, indicating community relevance and responsiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application pathway: Design & Our Town discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: To apply, select the Design & Our Town discipline within the Grants for Arts Projects program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must submit through the Grants for Arts Projects program and choose the correct discipline (Design & Our Town) to be considered for this funding.
